verdict.rationale: Docs show a single Gateway-managed API key (or OIDC token) replaces direct provider keys, with per-API-key usage tracking and budget caps that imply teams/apps can have distinct managed keys, and BYOK/system-credential fallback keeps raw provider secrets out of app code. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard walkthrough for creating/rotating multiple named keys per team or app, and documentation of per-key role/permission scoping.
